_about: Track reference (State Blob White Paper V1, layer 6). One entry per F1 25 track id. Sector-level location needs nothing from here (the sector start distances come off the wire in the Session packet). Corner-level location is used ONLY when 'calibrated' is true: run tests/calibrate_track.py over a real capture of the track, copy the fitted dist_m values in, review them against a lap you know, then set calibrated to true. Until then the corners list is names only and the booth says 'through the final sector', never 'into turn six'. 'character' and 'overtaking_spots' are plain-language facts the writer may use as colour; every capitalised word in them is licensed when they are offered.

14.name: Abu Dhabi
14.character: Yas Marina is a power circuit with two long straights and a slow, twisting final sector under the hotel, so the passing comes at the end of the straights and the lap is lost or won in the last sector
overtaking_spots: the end of the back straight
the end of the second straight
turn one, with a good exit from the final corner

17.name: Austria
17.character: the Red Bull Ring is short and fast, three big braking zones on the climbs and a quick run back down, so the field stays close and a small mistake costs a place
overtaking_spots: turn three at the top of the hill
